newsFlag.summary: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan stated that Mike Evans' injury from Sunday is not considered a long-term issue.
Justin Jefferson sustained an ankle sprain but has a chance to play Sunday against the Dolphins.
Jalen Hurts was temporarily knocked out of the first half after a hit by Bears linebacker D'Marco Jackson but returned to play in the Eagles' 27-7 loss to Chicago.
Travis Etienne Jr. suffered a hamstring injury in Sunday's game against the Raiders and will miss time, with no specific timeline provided for his return.
Breece Hall suffered a quad injury in Sunday's game against the Lions and is considered week-to-week.
Jaxson Dart is out for the season due to injury.
